title.zh-TW: 工具列提示框的延遲與暖機
title.en: Toolbar tooltips with delay and warm-up

summary.zh-TW: 編輯器工具列：滑鼠停一下才出現說明（避免滑過就閃）；說明出現後移到旁邊的按鈕，提示框直接滑過去，不用再等。鍵盤移到按鈕上會立刻顯示。
summary.en: An editor toolbar: the hint appears only after a short pause so passing over doesn’t flash; once visible, moving to a neighbour slides it across instantly. Keyboard focus shows it right away.

text.zh-TW: 第一次要停 0.45 秒才出現。太短的話，只是滑過工具列也會一直閃出提示框。
text.en: The first hint waits 0.45s. Any shorter and merely sweeping across the toolbar keeps flashing hints.

text.zh-TW: 提示框剛消失的 0.4 秒內移到其他按鈕，會立刻顯示。使用者已經在「看說明」，不該每個都再等一次。
text.en: Within 0.4s of a hint closing, the next one appears instantly. The user is already reading hints — don’t make them wait each time.

text.zh-TW: 整頁只有一個提示框，移到別的按鈕就用 GSAP 滑過去，比每個按鈕各自淡入淡出更穩定、不閃。
text.en: There is one tooltip for the page; moving between buttons slides it over with GSAP, steadier than each button fading its own.

text.zh-TW: 顯示時把按鈕和提示框連起來，讀屏軟體會在按鈕名稱後唸出說明和快捷鍵。
text.en: While shown, the button points to the tooltip so screen readers read the hint and shortcut after the button name.
